plot: The travel segment is compressed into practical breakdowns and resource losses.
Joeri is kept alive as a wagon driver and practical helper.
The convoy reaches Starfall領 and sees the broken gate, dead fire tower, unused west well, damaged wall, and distrustful locals.
The gate bone bells or west well pollution call Laine by his true name, pulling him toward the well.
Laine is physically harmed when gripping the gate iron, causing blood contact with the title document and Starfire Map display.
Laine orders true names suppressed, uses lord-title address, establishes a temporary salt-fire boundary, and seals the west well.
resources_candidate: one fire-oil jar loses roughly half its content during travel
coarse salt and fire oil are consumed to establish a temporary boundary
the west well is sealed, causing immediate water pressure
character_state_candidate: Laine becomes the direct target of the first supernatural crisis.
Joeri functions as an auxiliary driver and light pressure valve, not a sacrifice.
Ossa appears as a local protector who acts before trusting Laine.
Gareth provides urgent border experience: do not answer a name.
world_candidate: The west well and gate bone bells may pull at the legal name or lordship anchor of a newly arrived lord.
Calling true names near polluted boundary points is treated as dangerous in the opening.
goldfinger_candidate: Starfire Map displays name anchor, disconnected boundary, pollution pull, and extinguished fire tower, but gives no solution.
